notes.content: New and Import level is now disabled on Steam Deck as the Editor doesn't support touch screen.

notes.title: World of Goo 2 Developer Level Editor Now Available in Steam Workshop!
notes.content:
We've decided to release our in-house editor via Steam Workshop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546311/b7d0c87eacbab263e1f60a36cf5dd16775c346f1.gif

We built the editor just for us, and did not originally plan to share it. It's unpolished, unsupported, and gloriously unbeautiful - but it built all the levels in World of Goo 2 - and now it's publicly available for brave players to build and share their own levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546311/1a9ffce8ef49f8a2620fb13cd5a26cb7f3e666c2.gif

How do you get the level editor? Just update your game and look for a new button on the main screen. It's available right now on all Win/Mac/Linux platforms.

Here’s a video a player put together showcasing some of the levels our test community has built:
[previewyoutube=OwlBIWKrVP4;full][/previewyoutube]

IN PLUSHIE NEWS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546311/a5fbeb61065b8a9012e5961aa3b8c7f8c642016d.png

We partnered with Makeship to release these delightful, limited edition Goo Ball plushies! If you’ve ever dreamed of building your very own, in-home Tower of Goo (or wanted to throw one across the room while screaming “YAMAKO!”), now’s your chance!

They’re only available until Friday, June 27, 2025, so goo grab yours today!

More details here: https://www.makeship.com/products/goo-ball

notes.title: Linux hotfix #1
notes.content: Linux build of the game will still use X11 but will only show an error when X11 can't be initialized.

notes.title: World of Goo 2 bug fixes and Steam Deck compatibility improvements
notes.content:
Hi everybody! 

We've released a new update this week that adds: 

 offline mode
 Steam Deck improvements
 and various other bug fixes!

Download it today and stay tuned for some more exciting World of Goo 2-related news later this month!

Our Steam launch has gone well thus far and we wanted to express our appreciation to everyone for playing and helping spread the good word. If you haven't yet, please consider leaving a review on the game's store page. Special thanks to the nearly 300 World of Goo 2 owners that have already done so!

LAUNCH SALE ENDS ON FRIDAY, MAY 9, 2025!
And for those that haven't picked up the game yet: there are just a couple of days remaining before the launch discount (15% off) and World of Goo 1 loyalty discount (additional 15% off) come to an end. If you've wishlisted WOG2, the time to pick up the game is now before these offers are gone!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385670/World_of_Goo_2/

It’s April 25th, 2025!!... So that means that…World of Goo 2 – the followup to the indie-hit classic World of Goo, which was released almost 17 years ago…is NOW AVAILABLE!

What about Launch Discounts?!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32975417/5d133427efa6418158c451e9950bc8736c554329.png

Starting today through May 9th we’re offering a launch discount of 15% off World of Goo 2, and if you already own the award winning World of Goo… you’ll get an additional 15% off as an extra Thank You from the World of Goo 2 team!(🔥‼️) 

We’re also running a bundle for additional savings if you also want to buy the soundtrack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681380/World_of_Goo_2_Soundtrack/

Thanks to everyone for your help and support. We hope you love this game as much as we loved building it!

Your Friends at Tomorrow Corporation and 2DBOY

notes.title: World of Goo 2 Coming to Steam on April 25, 2025!
notes.content:

World of Goo 2 is coming to Steam on April 25! There will be three ridiculous new levels, designed especially for the most clever, the most hardcore, the most goo-imbued players. (Even some of the development team have been unable to complete them.)

Updates will include:

 Three new extremely difficult challenge levels.
 Over 30 Extra Fabulous Achievements.
 A Brand New Options Menu! Never before included in a 2DBOY or Tomorrow Corporation game.

notes.title: World of Goo 2 Launching Q2 2025!
notes.content:
The original World of Goo came out more than 15 years ago. The world is a little older now, and so are we. And you. You can’t stop progress!

Welcome, World of Goo 2 -- releasing this Spring on Steam with: 

 Extra Fabulous Steam Achievements
 Acclaimed Original Soundtrack
 And more! 

Wishlist it now!

[previewyoutube=bip_GGiFqec;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve been quietly readying World of Goo 2 for new platforms in a continued effort to help World of Goo fans answer the important questions: What happens if you poke Goo with a stick? How has the world changed after all this time? What new gameplay possibilities will we discover? What wonderful new creatures, and characters, and ancient monuments will we meet?


Discover realistic, flowing, viscous liquid. Route its flow like a river, convert it into Goo Balls, extinguish fires, and solve puzzles.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/109b0149260cc522d5a862235cea5818efd87879.gif

WHAT STRANGE NEW CREATURES!
Discover new species of Goo: Jelly Goo, Liquid Launchers, Growing Goo, Shrinking Goo, Explosive Goo, and more. All with mysterious new properties.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/f063d50ec6f59fe112f70545b44038da4b782636.gif

IT SOUNDS LIKE…
World of Goo 2 has dozens of new musical tracks in a beautiful and haunting new soundtrack.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/a9ed3e1c854fec9814cb3fa22d9f7aee29b89740.gif

WELCOME TO…
A thrilling new story to explore over the course of 5 new chapters, bursting with over 60 new levels, each featuring additional challenges.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/57b2940e9c03e8fb3c802cb33da01ed408af461c.gif

YOU ARE NOT ALONE...
A powerful company has re-branded as an environmentally friendly, sustainable, green, clean, Goo processing non-profit.Help them collect as much Goo as possible. But what do they really want? Explore a new story spanning hundreds of thousands of years and watch the world change.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/184de253918ef612cf7e7f3b6b5f79744e6c4dda.gif

LET’S SEE WHAT HAPPENS THIS TIME.
Be careful! The world is beautiful, but it is dangerous. Guide as many Goo Balls into the exit pipe of each area as you can. ...but what's on the other end of the pipe?

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/7695cab73bbe9ec51791012d5bb661c4a50bbb20.gif
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/3c0a57da8abada985b8a7546daa8f5ec688daf5f.gif
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/fd2b2c52881e5a32b5aaa33e908bf21df9433829.gif

The original World of Goo developer 2DBOY has teamed up with Tomorrow Corporation to build the biggest game we’ve ever made. We hope you will love it as much as we’ve loved building and discovering this new world so far.
